written: 2026-11-04, before any v9 job and before any v8 result
reason: The stress suite on the v7 bundle (outputs/eval/v7_fused_stress.json) gave pixelate24 0.6898, pixelate12 0.7828, downscale_0.125 0.8180 and blur_sigma4 0.8474 against 0.8855 or better elsewhere. Training covers blocks up to 16 px, blur up to sigma 2 and down-scale to 0.25 only.
reference: v7 bundle, as in v8. v8 and v9 passers compete under the shared tie-break below.
change: two augmentation settings on top of the v7 recipe: --mosaic_max 32 (blocks 4 to 32 px) with mosaic_p 0.3, and --heavy_p (strong blur sigma 2 to 5 or bilinear round trip at scale 0.08 to 0.25, equal chance).

trios.w_s123: as w, seed 123, after scoring, for seed spread only
trios.wh_s123: as wh, seed 123, after scoring, for seed spread only

switch_rule.common_required: the four common checks of v8_prereg.json, against v7
switch_rule.route_c_stress: mean AUC over the stress variants except clean gains >= +0.02 vs v7 and is above the best p=0.15 trio available, and pixelate8 falls by no more than 0.005
switch_rule.pass: all common checks and at least one route
switch_rule.several_pass: across v8 and v9, take the highest mean AUC over the default, extended and stress variants
switch_rule.none_pass: keep the v7 bundle, or the v8 winner if v8 has one

limits: Route C is added after seeing the v7 stress numbers, and the trained ranges now cover pixelate12, pixelate24, downscale_0.125 and blur_sigma4, so those rows are in-distribution and the stress suite is no longer an unseen test. Six candidates on one validation fold, so the winner's gain is optimistic.
rerun_policy: rerun only for a crash, OOM or a run that did not learn. Candidates are scored once.
never: test images in any statistic or training
